rationale: The agent properly verified identity (name + zip matched a single user), checked orders with read-only tools, and correctly noted there was no delivered laptop order on record, avoiding any unauthorized changes. The agent also obtained no write confirmations and made no unsupported claims, and appropriately offered and completed a handoff when records didn’t support a return. However, the user explicitly requested that if a return wasn’t possible, the agent should see if the order could be canceled. There is a pending laptop order (#W2417020), which by policy is typically eligible for cancellation. The agent neither offered cancellation nor sought confirmation to proceed, thus failing to complete the user’s request where a policy-permitted action was available. Consequently, the outcome does not meet the pass bar of completing the request in line with policy.
